setup: The triple-angle formula for the tangent is used with tan theta equal to [[n]] or to 1/[[n]], and one part of the result is asked for.

steps.say: The formula is tan 3theta = (3t - t^3)/(1 - 3t^2), with t standing for tan theta.
With t = 1/[[n]] the nested fractions clear to 3 times [[n]]^2 - 1 over [[n]] times ([[n]]^2 - 3), and with t = [[n]] the formula stays 3 times [[n]] minus [[n]]^3 over 1 - 3 times [[n]]^2.
The question names one part of the form that matches its own value of tan theta, either the numerator or the denominator, and the value is read from there.
